A small update: paste works, and the newest Support Fins engine is built in.

## Fixed

- **Copy and paste work with other programs.** A number copied somewhere else (a web page, a spreadsheet, your slicer) can now be pasted into a size box with Ctrl+V, and text copied in STL Editor can be pasted elsewhere. Before, copy and paste only worked inside the app. The browser edition already did this.

## Support Fins

- **Support Fins 1.0.12 is built in**, in the downloads and in the browser edition. If you already have 2.0, the app had fetched this engine by itself; a fresh download now starts with it.

## Getting it

- **If you have 2.0:** the app tells you there is a new version. On Windows, **Update now** downloads it, checks it and restarts. On Mac and Linux, use the **Download** button.
- **New here?** Windows: download **STL-Editor-2-Windows.exe**, put it anywhere and double-click it. It isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info › Run anyway**.
- **Mac (beta):** download **STL-Editor-2-macOS.app.zip** and unzip it. The first time, right-click it and choose **Open**.
- **Linux (beta):** download **STL-Editor-2-x86_64.AppImage**, make it executable and run it.
- **In your browser:** https://natterman12.github.io/STL-Editor/app/

Everything that was new in 2.0 is in the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/natterman12/STL-Editor/releases/tag/v2.0.0).
